name: Stabilus SE
summary: Stabilus SE, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, production, and distribution of gas springs, dampers, electromechanical damper opening systems, vibration isolation products, and industrial components in Germany, other European countries, the Middle East, Africa, North America, South America, the Asia-Pacific, and internationally. The company offers pneumatic and electronic grippers, clamps, and tools for robotics, as well as indexers and conveyors. It also provides motion control for electronic and mechanical solutions; and consulting and other services.
